title: Nextera DNA Flex NGS Library Prep: Post Tagmentation Cleanup
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs the 'Post Tagmentation Cleanup' section of the [Nextera DNA Flex Library Prep protocol](https://www.illumina.com/products/by-type/sequencing-kits/library-prep-kits/nextera-dna-flex.html). Links: * [Cherrypick Samples](./nextera-flex-library-prep-cherrypick-samples) * [Tagment DNA](./nextera-flex-library-prep-tagment-dna) * [Post Tagmentation Cleanup](./nextera-flex-library-prep-post-tag-cleanup) * [Amplify Tagmented DNA](./nextera-flex-library-prep-amplify-tagmented-dna) * [Cleanup Libraries](./nextera-flex-library-prep-cleanup-libraries) --- * [Opentrons magnetic module](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products/magdeck) * [Bio-Rad Hard Shell 96-well low profile PCR plate 200ul #hsp9601](bio-rad.com/en-us/sku/hsp9601-hard-shell-96-well-pcr-plates-low-profile-thin-wall-skirted-white-clear?ID=hsp9601) * [USA Scientific 12-channel reservoir 22ml #1061-8150](https://www.usascientific.com/12-channel-automation-reservoir.aspx) * [P300 Single/multi-channel electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes) * [300ul Opentrons tipracks](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-300ul-tips) --- Add 10ul of TSB to each sample, seal the plate with Microseal B, place on the preprogrammed thermal cycler, and run the PTC program. 12-channel reservoir (slot 3) * channel 1: TWB * channel 2: TWB **(only needed if number of samples > 48)** * channel 12: liquid waste (loaded empty)
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck and labware
steps.instruction: Arrange all required consumables on the OT‑2 deck: place the Bio‑Rad Hard Shell 96‑well low‑profile PCR plate (200 µL) in the magnetic module slot, load a USA Scientific 12‑channel 22 mL reservoir (catalog #1061‑8150) into slot 3, fill reservoir channel 1 with TWB, fill channel 2 with TWB only if processing more than 48 samples, leave channel 12 empty for liquid waste, and load a 300 µL Opentrons tiprack in its designated tip‑rack slot.

substeps.instruction: Place PCR plate in magnetic module
Add TWB to reservoir channel 2 (if >48 samples)

steps.title: Configure pipette and sample count
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, specify the mount side for the P300 single‑/multi‑channel electronic pipette and enter the total number of samples to be processed.

steps.title: Add TSB and run thermal cycler
steps.instruction: Using the P300 pipette, dispense 10 µL of TSB into each well of the plate, seal the plate with a Microseal B film, place the sealed plate on the pre‑programmed thermal cycler, and execute the PTC program.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 10 µL TSB into each well

steps.title: Run Opentrons protocol
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file, upload it to the Opentrons App, perform calibration of labware, tiprack, and pipette as prompted, then press “Run” to start the automated post‑tagmentation cleanup.
